posts.title: The multiplier effect: How authoring tools can transform web accessibility
posts.description: In the W3C blog post The multiplier effect: How authoring tools can transform web accessibility, W3C WAI Director Shawn Lawton Henry covers how authoring tools can help make vast amounts of content more accessible with less effort.

posts.title: Crafting WCAG 3 for more accessible user experiences
posts.description: In the W3C blog post Crafting WCAG 3 for more accessible user experiences, W3C WAI Director Shawn Lawton Henry covers some of the stakes and challenges in developing W3C Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 3.
